The method addresses the challenge of extracting clean meshes from 2D Gaussian splatting, which often produces noisy geometry due to the unbounded nature of the reconstruction.
It builds on the shared principles of projection-based culling [16407-projection-based-culling.md], extending them with multi-view aggregation and connected component filtering.
